journey.name: connection recovery during required wallet restore
journey.description: Use a disposable dev wallet and a controlled recovery fixture with an acknowledged complete wallet backup. Prepare a failing Electrum endpoint and a reachable replacement, plus a backup SETTINGS record containing the old endpoint. Required WALLET and USDT recovery must remain pending until their imports succeed. Never reset an existing wallet or use live funds. The installed Compose cases cover the editor and admission UI; repository tests cover persistence, cancellation and concurrent restore. They do not execute this complete authenticated journey. iOS restores required backup state before starting a rebuilt node; Android can need a running node during restoration. Record each platform’s app evidence with its tested revision and fixture limits; a pass on one platform does not establish this journey on the other.

actions.action: Restore the fixture wallet and verify failed node startup offers Connection Settings without access to ordinary wallet actions
Open Connection Settings and verify the screen tagged WalletConnectionRecovery is visible without Proceed Without Backup
Enter the reachable Electrum endpoint in RecoveryElectrumInput and tap RecoveryElectrumSave; verify RecoverySaved appears without automatically retrying restoration
Change and save RGS independently; verify a failed probe shows RecoveryError and retains the last acknowledged correction
Return to the restore error and tap Try Again; verify the node is rebuilt using the saved correction before required wallet restoration resumes

While required recovery remains unavailable, background and foreground three times and tap Try Again; verify the correction and gates remain and no already-running node is rebuilt solely because the unchanged correction is retained
Keep required recovery unavailable and restart the app; verify the correction is retained and spending remains gated
Allow restoration of the old SETTINGS backup; verify only the explicitly corrected endpoints override that backup and unrelated preferences restore normally
Complete required WALLET and USDT recovery; verify ordinary wallet actions become available only after both acknowledgements
Repeat with only optional profile enrichment unavailable after required recovery; verify ordinary wallet actions remain available and no failed-node-startup or restore-retry screen appears
